verdict.rationale: Visa publishes some of the surrounding pieces in the open. The Trusted Agent Protocol spec and its runnable reference implementation (tap-agent, cdn-proxy, merchant-backend, agent-registry) are on GitHub, and a live probe confirmed they ship under an open license. The Agent Toolkit / MCP server is also a public GitHub repo. The core Intelligent Commerce platform (token provisioning, mandates, credential retrieval) is a credential-gated hosted API with no published source. Missing for 10: open source of the core Intelligent Commerce platform, an explicitly stated license for the agent-toolkit repo, and independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
